children: Cycurion announced approximately $800,000 in annual contract spend from new pharmaceutical, NACCHO and other commercial/public-health engagements.
Approximately $800,000 in aggregate annual contract spend across new commercial and public-health engagements.
Includes first public announcement of a pharmaceutical engagement to support an AI Center of Excellence.
New award from the National Association of County and City Health Officials (NACCHO) deepens an existing relationship.
Scope covers business continuity, disaster recovery, cybersecurity assessments, program management, and organizational change management.
Marks execution of Cycurion’s strategy to accelerate expansion into commercial healthcare, life sciences and non-government markets while retaining government/public-safety work.
